meta.question: on CUB, does how confidently wrong the masked teacher's soft label is (max prob when its argmax differs from the full teacher's) rank-predict student val accuracy at K=12,29,49, incl. ToMe?
meta.method: keep-only masked-teacher faithfulness (KL, DKD target-class KD term) under each selector's mask, validated against trained students by within-K Spearman correlation and permutation test
meta.paper: Hooker et al. NeurIPS 2019 (keep-only evaluation); Zhao et al. CVPR 2022 (DKD); Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (rollout); Bolya et al. ICLR 2023 (ToMe); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD)
